title: Network, Temple and Wildheart profile kits carry a Questions page of their own
detail: Each profile kit on the Network, Temple and Wildheart themes now has a `questions` page after Home, the main page and About: the niche's FAQ in the theme's own FAQ block, a short lead, and an Ask us contact block. The words are the Home page's, so a Space that changes theme keeps its meaning. Nocturne (the midnight id) is left to the Nocturne design-system thread.

verify.evidence: profile-variants.ts builds a questions page for Network, Temple and Wildheart.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("lib/sites/kits/profile-variants.ts","utf8");if((t.match(/questions\(spec/g)||[]).length<3){console.error("a profile kit lost its Questions page");process.exit(1)}'
